bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and large bags over 12 x 12 x 8 inches aren't allowed. Outside food and drink and pets are also prohibited.
allowed: Bags 12 x 12 x 8 inches or smaller
prohibited: Backpacks or bags over 12 x 12 x 8 inches
bagPolicy.quote: BACKPACKS OR LARGE BAGS OVER 12" X 12" X 8"

parking.summary: Green Room lists nearby parking at the Mozaic Art Ramp, Uptown Row Parking Garage, The Walkway Parking Garage and Seven Points Parking Garage.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Green Room. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The kitchen is run by Parlour and serves food at most events, closing at 11 PM or 30 minutes before the event ends. Outside food and drink aren't allowed, and bringing outside alcohol gets you removed. Cash, card and tap to pay are accepted.

accessibility.summary: Service animals are welcome, though other animals and pets aren't allowed. Green Room hasn't published accessible seating or entrance details, so contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Green Room hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets on the Events page or at the box office during normal operating hours. You need a valid photo ID to enter and to claim will call tickets. Minors can attend age-limited shows with their own parent or legal guardian and proof of guardianship, but not after 10 PM.
ticketPickup.quote: You can purchase tickets at our box office during our normal operating hours.

gates.summary: Doors usually open about an hour before the music starts, most often at 7 PM. Check your event page for the exact door time.
gates.quote: We usually open doors about an hour before music starts.
